security_audit.summary: All 58 static findings are false positives involving expected API access, scoped authentication, remote page screenshots, documented token caching, or Markdown formatting. No evidence found of malicious intent, local screen capture, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection. Source review confirmed unsafe token-cache creation and partial token disclosure in authentication output as separate semantic findings.

remediation.issue: Token cache permissions are restricted only after the plaintext token is written.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary file with mode 0600 before writing, reject symbolic links, and atomically replace the cache.

remediation.issue: Authentication-only output exposes the first eight and last four token characters.
remediation.suggestion: Remove token_preview and report authentication status without credential fragments.

semantic_findings.title: Token Cache Written Before Permission Restriction
semantic_findings.description: save_cached_token writes a plaintext bearer token before applying mode 0600. A permissive umask can briefly expose new tokens; symbolic links are also followed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The write_text call precedes chmod and has no exclusive creation or symbolic-link protection. Exploitability depends on local permissions and attacker access.

semantic_findings.title: Partial Bearer Token Disclosure in Authentication Output
semantic_findings.description: The --auth-only output reveals the first eight and last four token characters when token length exceeds twelve. Captured logs can retain these credential fragments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The output expression directly slices the bearer token into stdout. This exposes credential fragments, not necessarily a complete usable token.

content.user_title: Retrieve Google Results and AI Overviews
content.value_statement: Manual Google research makes search results difficult to reuse in automated workflows. This skill retrieves structured results, AI Overviews, and follow-up answers through Pangolinfo APIs.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve organic Google result titles, URLs, and snippets in standard SERP mode.
Extract available AI Overview text and source references from provider responses.
Run Google AI Mode searches with repeatable follow-up questions.
Request remote Google page screenshots and return screenshot URLs when available.
Print extracted search data or the raw API response as structured JSON.
Authenticate using configured credentials or cached tokens, refresh invalid tokens with login credentials, and retry network failures.
limitations: Requires Python 3.6 or later, internet access, a Pangolinfo account, and sufficient API credits.
AI Overviews and screenshots depend on provider responses and are not guaranteed for every query.
Queries and follow-up questions are sent to an external provider; the skill cannot run searches offline.
Amazon scraping and local screen capture are not supported.

use_cases.title: Inspect Search Visibility
use_cases.description: Retrieve organic results and available AI Overview citations for selected keywords to support search visibility reviews.

use_cases.title: Build Search Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Use structured search output, task identifiers, and success indicators as inputs to a research pipeline.

use_cases.title: Explore Technical Topics
use_cases.description: Ask an initial AI Mode question, submit focused follow-ups, and inspect returned source references.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Basic Search Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Pangolinfo SERP mode to search for [topic]. Present returned organic titles, URLs, and snippets. Note whether an AI Overview is available.

prompt_templates.title: Review AI Overview Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [question] in SERP mode. Summarize any returned AI Overview and list its source references. Do not invent missing citations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect overview content and references

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options with Follow-Ups
prompt_templates.prompt: Use AI Mode to search for [topic]. Submit follow-ups asking about [comparison] and [constraint]. Summarize returned answers and references without assuming separate per-turn records.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Pipeline Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Run one SERP query for [public keyword] with [result count] requested results and remote screenshot enabled. Inspect raw output. Report success, task identifier, available result fields, and screenshot URL. Do not expose credentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: inspect provider output for pipeline integration

Organic result: Java Tutorial for Beginners, with its returned URL and snippet.
A provider-hosted screenshot URL and task identifier are included when returned.

output_examples.input: Search for JavaScript in AI Mode and list the returned references.
output: Illustrative output based on the bundled API example, not a live search.
AI Overview: JavaScript is a high-level programming language...
The response includes success status, result count, and task identifier.

best_practices: Provide PANGOLIN_TOKEN through a secret manager; keep cached tokens and authentication output private.
Send only approved public queries, and verify important claims against the returned source references.
Keep AI Mode follow-ups to five or fewer, and check success status before consuming results.
anti_patterns: Submitting confidential text or credentials as search queries or follow-up questions.
Treating AI Overview content as verified fact or assuming every query returns an overview.
Running large unbudgeted query batches without checking provider credits and failure responses.

faq.question: How do I configure authentication?
faq.answer: Set PANGOLIN_TOKEN, or provide PANGOLIN_EMAIL and PANGOLIN_PASSWORD. The client checks the environment token, its local cache, then login credentials.

faq.question: Which tools and runtime does this skill support?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The bundled client requires Python 3.6 or later and uses only the standard library.

faq.question: Does each search consume credits?
faq.answer: Bundled documentation lists two credits per successful AI Mode or SERP request. Confirm current pricing and account balance with Pangolinfo.

faq.question: Why is an AI Overview missing?
faq.answer: Not every query produces an AI Overview. The client includes overview content only when the provider returns it.

faq.question: Does the screenshot option capture my screen?
faq.answer: No. It requests a remote screenshot of the searched Google page and returns a provider-hosted URL when available.

faq.question: Can this skill scrape Amazon products?
faq.answer: No. Amazon scraping moved to a separate skill. The legacy Amazon mode prints a migration message and exits without scraping.
